_doc: How Palworld characters appear to Minecraft. One row = one class of character, tested top to bottom. kind refers to flags.json group ent ('-' = not listed).
rows: is the pawn of the local player
never listed: it is the stand-in for Steve
a player character that is not this PC's own
never listed: system coop_players draws it as a Minecraft player
a character Palworld has switched off: its collision is disabled
never listed: a party Pal that is not out waits high above its owner
PalCharacter that belongs to the local player
syndicate, merchants: Palworld decides what attacking them means
